_comment: Halo Battles game server (Nakama with the halobattles plugin). See deploy/pterodactyl/README.md.
name: Halo Battles
author: halobattles@users.noreply.github.com
description: The Halo Battles game server: Nakama 3.41.0 with the halobattles plugin and the base Mod baked into the image. Needs a Postgres 16 database elsewhere, such as a second server on the community Postgres egg.
startup: /nakama/nakama (started by the image's entrypoint from the variables below, on port {{SERVER_PORT}})

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# The server and the base Mod are in the image. mods/ is where the server's
# owner uploads more, each in a folder named after it.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mods

variables.name: Database address
variables.description: The Postgres database, as user:password@host:port/database. Migrated on every start.

variables.name: Server key
variables.description: The key clients send to connect. Must match the client build's VITE_NAKAMA_SERVER_KEY. Not secret: it ships in the client.

variables.name: Session encryption key
variables.description: Signs session tokens. Long and random; changing it signs everyone out.

variables.name: Session refresh encryption key
variables.description: Signs refresh tokens. Long and random, and different from the session key.

variables.name: Runtime HTTP key
variables.description: Guards server-to-server RPC calls. Long and random.

variables.name: Console signing key
variables.description: Signs console sessions. Long and random.

variables.name: Console port
variables.description: Leave empty to keep the admin console private to the container. To reach it, add a second allocation and enter its port here.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: Comma-separated Mods to load, base first. Each is found in the image, or else in the server's mods/ folder (upload a Mod there as a folder named after it, then restart). Every Match on this server uses all of them.
